```{python}
#| label: download

import pathlib
import csv
import sparknlp
import gutenbergpy.textget
from pyspark.sql import SparkSession
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

spark: SparkSession = sparknlp.start()
books = spark.read.csv("books.csv", header=True)

@F.udf
def download_book(id):
    print(f"Downloading book with ID {id}...")
    try:
        raw = gutenbergpy.textget.get_text_by_id(id)
        text = gutenbergpy.textget.strip_headers(raw).strip().decode("utf-8")
        return text
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Failed to download book with ID {id}: {e}")

books = books.withColumn("text", download_book(books.id))
```
